_meta.purpose: Override orgName for MU Calendar events by title pattern. Applied AFTER customerName is read and WINS over it — an explicit Customer value IS replaced when a pattern matches (scrape.js: 'Title-pattern override wins over whatever generic customerName the calendar carries'). Also applied to GetInvolved event titles. Two uses: (1) fill the host when the calendar's Customer is blank; (2) re-attribute rows the poster filed under themselves — e.g. Campus Recreation posts club-sport games on the main calendar, and the Sports page keys its MU Clubs tiles on orgName, so without an override Campus Rec shows up as a club (2026-09-30).
_meta.rule: Each entry: titlePattern (regex string, case-insensitive) + orgName. First match wins. orgName must be the exact Engage roster name (clubs.json) so tiles, twin-collapse keys and orgShortName all line up. Add new entries as you spot events with 'MU' pills that should be attributed to a specific host.
